source_title: 'We as a family together are dealing with it': Daler Mehndi’s son Gurdeep thanks Mika Singh amid Uttarakh - The Times of India

Gurdeep said his family was dealing with the situation together and thanked members of the entertainment industry for standing by them. His remarks come as several celebrities, including Kapil Sharma and Sudesh Lehri, have voiced their support for Daler.Gurdeep Mehndi opens up about familyâs responseIn a video shared on his official social media account on Saturday, Gurdeep revealed that he was outside India when the controversy emerged. Daler responded in his characteristic cheerful manner, assuring his son that he was doing well.According to Gurdeep, his fatherâs response was simply 'first class'. The expression later became a talking point after Daler used it during an event. Thank you to everyone for the support, to the film industry, including my chacha ji, Mika Singh," Gurdeep said. He also urged people to continue supporting the family as they navigate the ongoing situation. Gurdeep ended his message by invoking his fatherâs familiar expression. "Continue to shower your love on us in this manner. Please support us. Like Papa says, Rab Rakka," he added.Gurdeep provides an update on Daler Mehndiâs healthBefore sharing his latest message, Gurdeep had reassured people about his fatherâs health. While he avoided commenting extensively on the controversy, he offered a positive update during an interaction with IANS. "He is first class, fantastic, super hit, and best of luck," Gurdeep told the news agency.Kapil Sharma and Sudesh Lehri extend supportMika Singh is among the prominent entertainment personalities who have publicly supported Daler during the controversy. Comedian Kapil Sharma and actor-comedian Sudesh Lehri have also expressed solidarity with the singer.Mika Singh shared a video defending Daler and discussing the professional commitments artists undertake. He questioned claims about his brotherâs physical condition and explained that performers sometimes honour prior commitments even when they are unwell."Have you ever seen a glass of alcohol in his hand, or seen alcohol flowing freely at his birthday parties? No, you have not. Jab aapne dekha hi nahi, toh aapne kaise keh diya unse khada nahi hua jaa raha. Hum artists kayin baar kisi ke kehne par haan kar dete hain 'yes we will do the show'. Even if we have a 104-degree fever, it doesn't matter. If I am sick, and I have a show day after tomorrow, and I have already committed, then even if the budget is big or small, I will do it. Inhone (Daler) bhi aisa hi kiya hoga."Mika suggested that Daler might have honoured his commitment despite facing difficulties.Mika Singh took to X on September 24 to share a photograph with Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Dhami, revealing that the latter had contacted him personally to address the controversy involving Daler Mehndi. Mika said he had asked the Chief Minister to urge Uttarakhand Minister Subodh Uniyal to issue a video message apologising to the veteran singer. Uniyal had reportedly embarrassed Daler on stage by accusing him of being 'drunk'.In his post, Mika spoke about his regard for Dhami and welcomed the Chief Minister's decision to reach out to him over the issue."I have immense respect for the Hon'ble Chief Minister of Uttarakhand, @pushkardhamiji. He personally called me regarding the matter involving Daler Bhai, and I truly appreciate his gesture."I know Dhami Saab very well. He is a humble, down-to-earth person, and I have great respect for him," wrote Mika Singh. The singer said his request to Dhami was aimed at resolving the dispute and restoring Daler's dignity. He urged the Chief Minister to ask Uniyal to clarify his remarks and apologise publicly. "My only humble request to him is to please ask Shri @SubodhUniyal1ji to make a simple video clarifying his statement and apologising to Daler Bhai for saying that he was drunk during the performance. "I believe misunderstandings can happen, but they can also be resolved gracefully. I hope this small gesture will help put the matter to rest and ensure that Daler Bhai's dignity and reputation are respected," Singh wrote.Mika concluded his message by expressing confidence in the Chief Minister's ability to handle the matter. "I have faith in Dhami Saab's understanding and leadership," he added.
